newsitem.title: GREECE: OTE TO REVIEW BIDS FOR MOBILE PHONES DEAL.
newsitem.headline: OTE TO REVIEW BIDS FOR MOBILE PHONES DEAL.

text.p: Bids of an international tender for a joint mobile phone project between Greek OTE telecom and a foreign telecommunications firm were submitted to OTE officials on Friday, the company said in a statement.

OTE recently created a new company, Cosmote, for handling all mobile telecommunications issues. Cosmote's foreign partner will bear a 30 percent stake in Cosmote, company officials told a news conference last week.
The total investment will amount to 100 billion drachmas with half of the amount having been paid in by OTE. The balance will be borrowed after 1998, they added.
The three bidders are the American Air Touch, the Norwegian Telenor and the British Orange, all with extensive know-how in the international telecommunications sector.
A special committee set up to evaluate the bids unsealed the bidding documents today, it said.
OTE officials told reporters last Thurday that the results of the tender would be released in March. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
